justification: The strongest correspondences are the presence of profile human figures, profile quadrupeds, and plant/tree forms arranged at least partly in horizontal zones. The biggest difference is that A shows a coherent procession with humans walking and riding bovine-like animals beside formal trees and bordered by rosettes, while B shows much more schematic, separated animal, bird/plant, and sign-like figures stacked on a pillar with no comparable procession or riding relationship.
